title: Suggestion for a UI improvement
body: Perhaps the circle for the circle of the current day could turn any colour than red when a habit is in progress? In my opinion, red looks very discouraging, like the habit is already failed
author: rmnt__

title: No thanks
body: Poor application, you can only track 5 habits with regular version, and after a week developers will let you open the app only if you buy premium version first, which is 20€! Yearly.
author: blaöbla

title: I love it!
body: Works well, easy to manage, very smooth and uncluttered. Turns habit forming into fun!
author: Zakazastar
